steps.content: Meanwhile, data transmission for the Chief is in progress...

steps.speaker: Digitalized Corruptor
steps.content: Roarrrr...!
The chaotic data stream writhes, converges, and rushes at you, forming the familiar shape of Corruptors.
[Bang...! The Corruptor quivers and disappears]
With a flash of blue light, they crash into a semi-transparent barrier in front of you. Moore's communications resume immediately.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Attacks from an unknown source, which seems to have completely locked onto you. The attacks won't stop until your existence is completely erased.
But now you don't even have a physical form. How can you fight?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: I've set up a temporary firewall to protect you, but it's not enough.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Chief, listen to me. Use your shackles to the greatest extent possible.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But here, the shackles...

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Please trust me, it'll be fine. The firewall will protect you.
[Release the shackles]
You release your shackles, but they soon dissipate, making you dizzy. Just like 000 said, in this world, Mania is banned, and the shackles are useless.
But in that intense moment, you vaguely sense something different from the other end of the shackles.
[A white apparition (EMP) flashes across the screen]
Looking up, you see EMP's giant face showing on the screen.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Great! There's indeed a reliable Sinner nearby. I'll send you over. She will protect you.
[Flash]

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Chief?! Why are you here... Are you here to save me? Chief, you are really...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: I knew you'd come, Chief!! Waaaah! I've long admired your heroic deeds! The great superhero who single-handedly defeated Draco! Please, oblige me with your intrepid feat!!
...As expected, it's EMP. She rushes towards you, followed by the familiar pixelated little Draco.
Meanwhile, the abnormal data that had been chasing you penetrates the space, merging into the screen and turning into more monsters that lunge at you. Just then...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Yo, Chief. Rare to see you at your wits' end. Where's that swagger when you defeated Draco and then laughed at me? Need any help?
Another cartoon head pops out on the screen. This familiar voice, this striking purple... It's EMP's gaming playmate back at the Bureau—Mess.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Mess? How come you're here, too?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Well, it's still holiday, isn't it? We were in the middle of a game, where I was finally winning! But EMP tried to escape, so I had to get her back.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: But now it seems like... it's more fun over here, hehe. EMP, when did you become such a noob? Aren't you supposed to be a pro?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: ...It's not the same. Playing with a joy stick isn't the same as actually being hunted down!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Dumb, no matter how real you feel like being chased after, it's still just a game! Look...
She jumps forward to "Draco" and taps it. The dragon pauses, then opens its jaws and swallows Mess whole. EMP lets out a scream.
But before her scream even fades, Mess's purple head shoots out from the other side.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: See? Being eaten won't even give you a scratch. Stop hiding behind Chief. Didn't you always say that one day you'd show everyone what you're capable of?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Guess what, today is the day! This immersive game is perfect for you to build some guts. Remember how you rubbed it in my face every time you won? Just show a bit of that cockiness and you're good to go.
Though what she said makes perfect sense, you feel kind of weird seeing Mess being so kind and encouraging EMP.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Sob... She's right. After all, I am the Archer Queen of Syndicate, the Bureau's top gamer, and the indispensable part of the great duo, EMP x Mess. What's there to fear in a little interdimensional game? I'm gonna...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Aaaaah, I'm not up for this! Chief, run! I'll hold it off, run!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Hahahahahaha... the top gamer my butt. Finally, I get to have my way!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Yeah, I knew it, she just wants to see EMP making a fool of herself.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Isn't it great? Let's leave this game to the two who enjoy it most. Chief, we should head to your battlefield.
